response.sql: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(spent / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_spend_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
